issues.description: download_and_untar.sh warns about missing unzip but does not exit, then calls unzip anyway
issues.detail: The precondition check prints a warning and falls through under set -euo pipefail, so a missing unzip produces a confusing mid-run failure instead of a clean abort. Either exit non-zero on the check or remove it; a half-check is worse than none.

issues.description: Usage block prints but does not exit on wrong argc, falling through into realpath of unset $1
issues.detail: When argc is out of [1,2], the script cats usage and continues into realpath $1, which under set -u errors obscurely instead of failing cleanly. Add exit 1 after the heredoc to make the precondition real.

issues.description: Unquoted realpath arguments break under whitespace with set -u in effect
issues.detail: extract_dir=$(realpath $1) and realpath ${2:-$extract_dir} are unquoted; paths with spaces split into multiple words and crash. The rest of the script uses set -euo pipefail carefully — quote these too: realpath "$1".

issues.description: README links the ASR config at a path that does not exist
issues.detail: README points to ./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml but the file lives at ./conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml (no train/ subdir). The link 404s on GitHub. Fix the path.

issues.description: Transcript normalization is a brittle chain of seds with no stated target alphabet
issues.detail: Six sequential sed processes strip a hand-picked set of full-width punctuation plus a Cyrillic-looking A, with no specification of the legal output alphabet. Collapse into a single sed -e ... or tr -d and document the target character set so the filter is verifiable rather than folkloric.

issues.description: Three near-identical extraction blocks should collapse into one table-driven loop
issues.detail: TAL_ASR-1/2/3 each get a copy-pasted 9-line block differing only in zip name, target subdir, and label. Put the rows in a small here-doc table and loop, eliminating drift risk and ~30 lines. data.sh already uses this pattern; mirror it.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on a NEEDS-WORK verdict for a conventional ESPnet recipe whose supporting shell is sloppy under set -euo pipefail. Two precondition checks in download_and_untar.sh — missing-unzip and wrong-argc — print messages then fall through instead of exiting, which the panel treats as P0 fail-fast violations. Unquoted realpath arguments, a broken README config path, and a folkloric chain of sed substitutions round out the agreed P1s. Cleanups are small and obvious; the recipe structure itself is fine.
